description: This file defines the CommandParser class used for parsing modem command strings, including methods for skipping prefixes, extracting strings, and converting values. It is part of the 'cuttlefish' namespace and includes inline methods for command string manipulation.

classes.name: CommandParser
classes.description: A class for parsing and manipulating modem command strings, providing methods to skip parts of the command and extract values.

methods.name: SkipPrefix
methods.description: Skips the substring before the first '=' character, including '='.

methods.name: SkipPrefixAT
methods.description: Skips the next 'AT' substring in the command.

methods.name: SkipComma
methods.description: Skips the next comma in the command.

methods.name: SkipWhiteSpace
methods.description: Skips the next whitespace character in the command.

methods.name: GetNextStr
methods.description: Retrieves the next string segment from the command.

methods.name: GetNextStr(char flag)
methods.description: Retrieves the next string segment from the command, considering a specific flag.

methods.name: GetNextStrDeciToHex
methods.description: Converts the next decimal string to hexadecimal, used for AT+CRSM commands.

methods.name: GetNextInt
methods.description: Retrieves the next integer value from the command.

methods.name: GetNextHexInt
methods.description: Retrieves the next hexadecimal integer value from the command.
